title: One Day at 37
description:
One winter evening at thirty-seven, the café was closing. Chairs rose onto tables one by one. Daeun stopped at the door with one hand around her bag strap, took a step outside, then turned back with an expression more rigid than usual.

"Minjun, may I ask you something?"

She glanced once at the melting ice in her cup. "When you reach Gangnam, may I be beside you? Or... is this where we end?"

Four years of deferred words rose into {name}'s throat. The bell above the door swayed and went still. If he stayed silent again, silence would become the answer.

description_if_known.daeun_close_bond:
One winter evening at thirty-seven, the café was closing. Daeun stopped at the door with one hand around her bag strap, then turned back.

"When you reach Gangnam, may I be beside you? Or... is this where we end?"

{name} remembered the day she had said, "Let's hold on together." He had hidden behind gratitude, and she had never pressed for an answer. Only now did he understand that her patience had lasted four years.

The bell above the door swayed and went still. If he swallowed the words again, silence would become the answer.
description_if_known.daeun_late_call:
One winter evening at thirty-seven, the café was closing. Daeun stopped at the door with one hand around her bag strap, then turned back.

"When you reach Gangnam, may I be beside you? Or... is this where we end?"

{name} remembered their recent late-night call with no purpose. Both had said goodbye, then circled the same stories for another hour. After it ended, her breathing had seemed to remain in the room.

Perhaps he had known then and refused to give it a name. Before the bell above the door went still, he had to say that name aloud.
description_if_known.daeun_date_set:
One winter evening at thirty-seven, the café was closing. Daeun stopped at the door with one hand around her bag strap, then turned back.

"When you reach Gangnam, may I be beside you? Or... is this where we end?"

Looking back, it had begun with the ordinary words, "Let's have a meal sometime." Dates were set and postponed. One meal took years to become a promise across several seasons. Daeun had always stepped first and left room for {name} to follow.

He could not leave that room empty again. The bell above the door swayed, then slowly went still.

choices.text: "Together. No — I want us to go together." — an answer four years late
choices.result_text:
"Together. No, I want us to go together."

Daeun's hand stopped on the bag strap. Her eyes shone before the smile arrived, small and composed. "...So do I, Minjun. I have for a long time."

The clerk switched off the final row of lights. They left the café side by side. Outside the door, two sentences carried alone for four years finally pointed in the same direction.

choices.text: "I'm not sure yet. I think I'll know once I get there" — honest
choices.result_text:
"I still don't know. I think I have to reach Gangnam first."

Daeun adjusted her grip on the bag and nodded. "I understand. Thank you for being honest." She smiled, but her shoulders were straighter than usual when she opened the door first.

They walked in opposite directions from the café. In the place where he postponed an answer, he had not left even a request for her to wait.

title: Two Gangnams
description:
37. Near Gangnam.

Jiyeon reached out first.
"I'm coming up to Seoul this month. Let me know if you want to meet."

Looked at that message for a long time.

Thought about the time spent with Jiyeon. First it was an accident. Then a coincidence. At some point — it became a choice.

Both of them knew they were heading toward the same place, for similar reasons.

Needed to see her.

choices.text: Go to meet her — "I wanted to see you too"
choices.result_text:
Met at a cafe near Gangnam. She smiled first.
"Both of us made it here."
Neither had to say all of how they got there. They both already knew.

choices.text: "This is enough for what it was" — don't reach out
choices.result_text:
No reply sent. That world wasn't {name}'s to enter.
Jiyeon went to Gangnam. {name} was headed there too. Same city, different roads.

description_if_known.told_jiyeon_about_records:
37. Near Gangnam.

Jiyeon reached out first.
"I'm coming up to Seoul this month. Call me if you want to see me."

He stared at the message for a long time.

Once, Minjun had told her — that HanPD Construction was in the records of his father's fraud case. After that day she became someone who had looked down at the ground beneath her own feet for the first time.
Knowing it, neither of them turned away from the other.

They both knew they were heading toward the same place for similar reasons.
But now each of them knew where the other had come from, too.

He felt he had to go see her.
